What counts as similar?

Version 2 checks distinctive details and verifies their alignment. It can handle many crops, rotations and lighting changes. Balanced is the default. Similar-looking scenes, major viewpoint changes and weak evidence may still need manual selection. Coverage describes how widely matching details are spread; it is not a probability of correctness. Header and footer logos are preserved unless included.
